findings.text: non-blocking: `own` re-derives exactly the refs derive_wait_refs already returns (reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:2719 builds `run:{run_id}` from node.after with the identical expression and includes them on both of its return paths), so `own` is always a subset of `derived` and the union at :4093 is a no-op. The added definition duplicates the owner's computation rather than extending it, and the vestigial union keeps a stored-versus-derived distinction the code no longer makes, inviting a future reader to reintroduce a stored ref through it; the line can simply be deleted.
